finding-a-catalog-skill.notes: the generated catalog directory (#229). Every repo holding ANY catalog skill should hold this one -- it is the only artifact that travels and names the rest -- so all eight census-visible consumers are declared here and none subscribes yet: the weekly placement cross-check will file `missing` until each runs `npx skills add ... --skill finding-a-catalog-skill`. thrillmade/arlyn-working is deliberately NOT declared: it holds 23 catalog subscriptions but is absent from census_counters.CONSUMER_REPOS, so the census structurally cannot observe it and a declaration there would be a verdict that can never clear. Adding it to CONSUMER_REPOS is its own change
